# 003 U3/U4: jtml_coordinator is the Qt orchestration layer (optimize_coordinator,
# optimizer_manager). It consumes the single jtml_compute SHARED lib (via JTA_LIBS) --
# the compute sources moved out of the coordinator into jtml_compute in U4.
#
# Plan 006 U5/U6 (the shared VM layer): the OptimizerRunController surface joins
# this layer -- optimizer_run_controller_core.cpp (Qt/GPU-free run core: gate,
# run-state machine, epoch, progress mapping, seed lifecycle) +
# optimizer_run_driver.cpp (the OptimizerRunDriver seam + the production adapter
# wrapping OptimizerManager UNTOUCHED) + optimizer_run_controller.cpp (the QObject
# shell: the drive sequence, thread lifecycle + destructor contract, the 8
# by-value relay binds). U6 adds session_state_controller.cpp (the QObject
# notification shell over jta::SessionState: diff-based grouped emission, M9;
# previous-mirror advance on CommitSelection, H2; ResetForDatasetClear + seed
# drop, H5/M10b). Both front-ends drive the controllers; the view-specific
# mappers stay view-side.
#
# AUTOMOC: the Q_OBJECT headers (optimize_coordinator.h, optimizer_manager.h,
# optimizer_run_controller.h, session_state_controller.h) MUST be in the source
# list (via the coordinator header GLOB below) or AUTOMOC never mocs them ->
# undefined-vtable link error.
set(CMAKE_AUTOMOC ON)

file(GLOB HEADER_FILES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/include/coordinator/*.h
)

add_library(jtml_coordinator STATIC
    optimize_coordinator.cpp
    optimizer_manager.cpp
    optimizer_run_controller_core.cpp
    optimizer_run_driver.cpp
    optimizer_run_controller.cpp
    session_state_controller.cpp
    ${HEADER_FILES}
)

# Downward deps: services (-> domain) + the single SHARED compute lib
# (optimizer_manager uses gpu_*.cuh + CostFunctionManager.h => jtml_compute, merged U4).
target_link_libraries(jtml_coordinator PUBLIC jtml_services ${JTA_LIBS})
# Qt + VTK (via optimizer_manager/services), Torch + OpenCV + CUDA (compute).
target_link_libraries(jtml_coordinator PRIVATE
    ${REQUIRED_LIBS_QUALIFIED}
    ${VTK_LIBRARIES}
    ${TORCH_LIBRARIES}
    ${OpenCV_LIBRARIES}
    ${CUDA_LIBRARIES}
)

# Adding Include Directories. include/compute resolves the bare/resolver gpu/cost
# headers (gpu_*.cuh, pose_matrix.h, camera_calibration.h) in optimizer_manager + the
# cost managers; CUDA includes for the compute path.
target_include_directories(jtml_coordinator PUBLIC
    ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/include
    ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/include/compute
    ${CUDA_INCLUDE_DIRS}
)

# The compute + GPU/CUDA surface now lives in the jtml_compute SHARED lib, linked
# through ${JTA_LIBS}; no per-target CUDA flags or separable compilation are needed
# here (that is jtml_compute only).

# Plan 007 U2: Qt6 qmllint gate over the experimental app's QML files.
# Pins $CONDA_PREFIX/lib/qt6/bin/qmllint (the Qt 6.7.2 binary — the bare
# `qmllint` on PATH is Qt 5.15.8 from opencv's qt5 build and lacks --json).
# Fails on warnings outside the documented accepted set (see
# test/qml_lint.cmake for the accepted ids + their removal paths).
if(EXISTS "$ENV{CONDA_PREFIX}/lib/qt6/bin/qmllint")
    set(QML_LINT_QT6 "$ENV{CONDA_PREFIX}/lib/qt6/bin/qmllint")
elseif(EXISTS "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/.pixi/envs/default/lib/qt6/bin/qmllint")
    set(QML_LINT_QT6 "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/.pixi/envs/default/lib/qt6/bin/qmllint")
else()
    set(QML_LINT_QT6 "")
    # Review fix (ce-code-review 2026-08-12, AN2): the gate used to
    # silently vanish when no Qt6 qmllint was resolvable — a configure
    # warning makes the disappearance visible.
    message(WARNING "jtml.qml_lint NOT registered: Qt6 qmllint not found "
                    "($ENV{CONDA_PREFIX}/lib/qt6/bin or "
                    "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/.pixi/envs/default/lib/qt6/bin). "
                    "The bare 'qmllint' on PATH is Qt 5.15.8 and is never "
                    "used.")
endif()
if(QML_LINT_QT6)
    add_test(NAME jtml.qml_lint
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND}
            -D QML_LINT=${QML_LINT_QT6}
            -D QML_DIR=${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/app/experimental
            -D QML_OUT=${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/qml-lint-out.json
            -P ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/qml_lint.cmake)
    set_tests_properties(jtml.qml_lint PROPERTIES
        LABELS "headless" TIMEOUT 120
        WORKING_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}")
endif()

text:
** Finding 7 — The backend seam evolution is additive-first and deliberately minimal: payload + StageScript + named derivations, no new layer
- The "backend" is already a stack of three seams (OptimizerRunDriver, Optimize()'s stage loop, DirectOptimizer's injected std::function). The target shape: OptimizerRunLaunch stays the single by-value payload, additively gaining the DIRECT Options struct; the stage sequence becomes a StageScript (vector of StageSpec: {kind, range, budget, repeat, cfm_index}) that the same Optimize() executor consumes; dilation/dark-silhouette derivation (DeriveStageCostParams) and the cost-adapter construction (BuildGpuCostAdapter) become named pure functions; DirectOptimizer's boundary stays std::function<double(const Point6D&)>. Explicitly NO RunBackend enum (the driver IS the run-level backend — the fake driver proves it), NO new CMake target, NO headless executor extraction until the multi-stage oracle demonstrates the driver seam insufficient, NO ML in the loop. [Source: angles/04-backend-architecture.org, "Target shape", "non-goals"]
- Dilation stays COST-owned: it is a derived property of the active CFM parameters (the "Dilation"/"dark_silhouette" name scan at optimizer_manager.cpp:237–345), not optimizer config — moving it would fork the single source of truth. The seam is the named pure function DeriveStageCostParams, called once in Initialize. This deliberately counters the dispatch's "dilation under optimizer configuration" framing. Round 3 sharpens this: the lineage's dilation values are themselves DATA (paper rule trunk−4 = 10/6/1 femur / 6/2/1 tibia; code 6/4/1; docs 6/3/1; BRANCH_DILATION_DECREASE is vestigial — appears in no .cpp), so the derivation function must return exactly what the CFM carries and the schedule lives in the manifest, not in constants. [Source: angles/04-backend-architecture.org, "Dilation stays COST-owned" + R3-1]
- Payload evolution contract: additive fields are FREE (DirectOptimizer::Options defaulted = today's behavior; the fake-driver test records the whole launch by value and compiles unchanged); restructuring into nested sections is ONE gated signature-adaptation cut with the test updated in the same change; the driver interface, Initialize signature, by-value forwarding, the 8 binds, and the epoch/threadActive gate never change. Do NOT move the 3 CFMs to pointers (perf decision pending measurement; would change the fake-driver copy semantics). [Source: angles/04-backend-architecture.org, "Payload evolution contract"]
- The stage loop stays in Optimize() and becomes script-driven in place: the loop is the only algorithm policy among three interleaved work kinds (session/GPU state and signal emission stay in the manager). RunDirectStage stays the stage runner; its injected lambda becomes BuildGpuCostAdapter, with three consumers converging on it (production runner, z-profile probe, and oracle_test's hand-rolled twin at oracle_test.cpp:286–291). A future gradient-polish stage is one StageSpec + one new StageKind + its own runner branch — same seam, no StageRunner interface built today. R13 gap honestly recorded: Optimize()'s loop has no headless emission-order pin today (manager is GPU-bound); Cut B's evidence is parity + oracle green + jj diff relocation + the new pure-function pins. Round 3 (angle 04 R3-3) redefines Cut B's preservation contract against the lineage: the golden pins only the trunk member, so the script-driven loop must preserve FOUR lineage invariants (group-once dilation across repeats; per-repeat re-seed from the current optimum — assert the recovered-pose SEQUENCE; asymmetric z-leaf; frame-to-frame seed chaining), each with an assertion home in the multi-stage oracle. [Source: angles/04-backend-architecture.org, "script-driven loop", "R13 pin surface", "Migration sketch" + R3-3]
- Round 2 (StageScript specifics): exact schema StageKind {Trunk=0, Branch=1, Leaf=2} + StageSpec {kind, range, budget, repeat, cfm_index}; repeat=0 expresses the Sym_Trap no-search leaf (init + dilate + emit run, search suppressed — verified against the sym_trap path); the branch group's CFM init + dilate + UpdateDilationBackground emit happen ONCE before the repeat loop (no per-repeat emit); the budget reset (budget_ = trunk_budget, cost_function_calls_ = 0) is a loop-start property, branch/leaf accumulate by design; the epilogue trunk-restore dilate + emit is transcribed. NEW finding: the leaf DestructActiveCostFunction is error-gated (:1144-1148) while trunk's destruct is unconditional — a likely narrow GPU-resource leak on the leaf-search-failure path; transcribe verbatim in Cut B, flagged to angle 02's bug list. DeriveStageCostParams/BuildStageScript live in include/coordinator/optimizer_stage_script.h + .cpp (one line in jtml_coordinator's explicit source list) so the direct-compile test pattern can compile them without the Qt/CUDA surface. Round 3 (angle 04 R3-1/R3-2): the schema is proven to express the LINEAGE config term-for-term (repeat=3, Point6D(5,5,20,5,5,5), cfm_index-carried dilation) — "stages as data" covers the lineage, not just today — and the convergence-tradeoff design note (cover is dropped at the stage loop, per the paper's own framing) lives in this TU; Options carries NO cover knob. [Source: angles/04-backend-architecture.org, R2-2 + R3-1/R3-2]
- Round 2 (Cut E falsifiable): the deferral gate is a decision procedure — inject a wrong-stage dilation emit into the production stage loop; if ANY of the three gates trips (per-frame IoU ≥ 0.85, costCalls on caps, qml_parity unchanged), the seam is sufficient at stage granularity and Cut E stays deferred; if none trips, the driver seam is demonstrated insufficient and StageKind dispatch + headless executor are sanctioned. The failing class is structurally invisible to the seam (the observation channel is counter-derived; a wrong-dilation emit changes no counter and no pose the 0.85-vs-0.9936 band can see). Precedent: OptimizeCoordinator/OptimizeWorker is already a headless single-stage executor (plan U4), so "headless executor" is not missing machinery — only stage-level dispatch over the GPU-bound loop is. [Source: angles/04-backend-architecture.org, R2-1]
- Round 2 (Cut F, torch boundary): exact situs — find_package(Torch REQUIRED) at CMakeLists.txt:77; ${TORCH_LIBRARIES} linked PUBLIC into jtml_compute (src/compute/CMakeLists.txt:67); the legitimate consumer segment_image (machine_learning_tools.cpp:7-71) compiled INTO jtml_compute (:45); the smell is the unused <ATen/ops/div_native.h> at CostFunctionManager.h:28 (grep-verified unused; forces every TU including the cost header to compile ATen). Cut F: delete the unused include + change the link from PUBLIC to PRIVATE (or layer-pure: move machine_learning_tools into services), both moves in one gated jj change (headless build green + oracle green + link-only diff). The design NO-GO on a torch bridge in the cost path stands — corroborated by LEAP's torch-free-core architecture (Finding 6) and by the DiffDRR family's existence (the low-level analytic Jacobian is the answer to "low-level generators lack gradients"). [Source: angles/04-backend-architecture.org, R2-5 + R3-4; angles/06-differentiable-polish.org R3-2]
- Round 2 (Options cut): DirectOptimizer::Options {selection=Original, epsilon=0.0, delta_limit=false, delta_limit_subdivisions=0, size_measure=L2, split_rule=OneSide, ties=All, hidden_constraints=false, globally_biased=false} maps line-by-line onto today's code (Jarvis gift-wrap with slope >= highest_slope, no ε filter; largest-denormalized one-side trisection; center sampling; L2 size; cumulative-budget loop guard). Bit-identical-defaults proof strategy: guarded divergence (every path guards on "different from default" before diverging) + the Tier-1 golden / PBT twin / oracle / parity as the numeric spec. Launch plumbing traced end-to-end: OptimizerRunLaunch → adapter verbatim forwarding (optimizer_run_driver.cpp:60-81) → Initialize member → RunDirectStage ctor (:1234); every DirectOptimizer call site verified four-argument today (optimizer_manager.cpp:1234, oracle_test.cpp:292, optimize_coordinator.cpp:36, test ×12, props ×3). One flagged verification: only the adapter constructs the manager per grep — check for legacy paths before landing. Round 3: the Options documentation must state the cover boundary — per-stage DIRECT cover is guaranteed, cross-stage cover is intentionally dropped by design (stage-script property; no cover knob in Options; angle 01's variant docs must not claim global-cover guarantees for the stage sequence). [Source: angles/04-backend-architecture.org, R2-6 + R3-2]

## Requirements

**[Graph container and schema]**

- R1. The optimizer run shape is a **graph**: an ordered sequence of stages
   (a path; variable length 1..N), each stage carrying {cost variant +
   parameters, optimizer variant, budget, ranges, seed semantics, repeat}.
   Edges are implicit: stage N+1 seeds from stage N's optimum.
- R2. Graphs are **C++-typed data in a named registry** (the
   `CostFunctionManager` registration pattern). The ablation manifest
   (`ablation.json`) references graphs by name and parametrizes only the
   declared ablation axes (dilation schedule + semantics, z-leaf budget, ε,
   Canny config, backface, render resolution). JSON never invents graph
   structure.
- R3. Each stage has an **optimizer-variant slot** (the
   `DirectOptimizer::Options` surface: selection, ε, split rule, gb phase
   switch, GLh, size measure) defaulting to today's classic DIRECT behavior
   bit-identically. In v1 the slot is empty/default everywhere — stage
   switching (e.g., GL-gb trunk → classic branches → polish leaf) is policy
   filled only after the harness scores it. The slot must accept any future
   stage kind: polish, an ML initializer prefix node, a no-search leaf.
- R4. Graph execution goes through the **existing seams**: the
   `OptimizerRunDriver` interface (`include/coordinator/optimizer_run_driver.h`),
   the `RunDirectStage` injected-cost lambda, the GPU cost path, and the IoU
   gates. No new layer, no RunBackend enum, no executor extraction — Cut E
   stays deferred behind its falsifiable gate (wrong-stage-dilation
   perturbation × three gates).
- R5. The schema must not preclude: biplane (the same costs over a second
   projection — a single 6-DoF pose transformed to the second image; z falls
   out of the DIRECT cost landscape naturally), a tiered-dilation cost
   variant, and a polish stage consuming the existing budget accounting
   (parity counting).

**[v1 graph set and feasibility PoC]**

- R6. The v1 registry ships **one graph: `jtml-production`** — the current
   production shape (trunk 20k → 2×branch 5k → leaf 5k, classic DIRECT
   everywhere, dilation 6/4/1). Other stage kinds may exist as stubs, but no
   alternate optimization scheme ships in v1. This is the feasibility PoC:
   stages-as-data over the existing engine.
- R7. The PoC must be **behavior-preserving**: same cumulative caps
   (20/25/30/35k), same stage bookkeeping, same recovered poses, oracle green
   (IoU ≥ 0.85), qml parity unchanged. Preservation is asserted via the
   lineage's four invariants with assertion homes in the multi-stage oracle:
   group-once dilation across branch repeats; per-repeat re-seed (assert the
   recovered-pose *sequence*, not just the final pose); asymmetric z-leaf;
   frame-to-frame seed chaining.

**[Measurement-first spine and gates]**

- R8. Sequencing is the research run's dependency-ordered path, confirmed

   live distance-map index fix → exactly one single-variable re-baseline,
   Canny pinned 3/0/150, recovered-pose delta recorded; plus the CUDA-free
   finite-check at `DirectOptimizer::EvaluateCostFunction` and the meter fix
   — see R10) → **Phase 1** measurement (z-profile probe → multi-stage oracle

# JTML — Agent Working Guide

JTML is a Qt6 (qt6-main/wayland 6.7.2) + VTK 9.3 built against Qt6 + CUDA 12.4 + OpenCV C++20 desktop app for 2D-3D knee-implant
registration (DIRECT global optimizer over a GPU cost function). This file captures the
conventions a coding agent needs to work here without re-deriving them.

## Build & environment (pixi)

Everything build-related is handled by pixi tasks — never invoke cmake/make/nvcc directly.

- `pixi run configure` — cmake configure (pulls deps; builds VTK once via `vtk_installer.sh`)
- `pixi run build` — build all targets (incl. the GUI + tests)
- `pixi run test` — run the **headless** test suite via `ctest -L headless --timeout 600`
- `pixi run run` — launch the GUI app
- `pixi add <pkg>` / `pixi run tidy` / `pixi run format` — deps / clang-tidy / clang-format

Add any new C++ test framework/tool to `pixi.toml` (the lockfile is `pixi.lock`).

## Version control is `jj` (Jujutsu), NOT git

- Always use `jj` commands. Never raw git.
- The repo owner's workflow is **`jj describe -m "<scope>: <msg>"` then `jj new`** for each
  logical change. `jj new` starts the next change after `describe`.
- `jj st` to see the working-copy change; `jj log --no-graph` to read history.

## Test suite

Layout under `test/`, all registered in `test/CMakeLists.txt`:
- `test/unit/` — **Catch2** pure-logic tests (no Qt event loop, no GPU): data structures,
  the pure `DirectOptimizer` (Tier-1 analytic golden), future persistence.
- `test/lifecycle/` — **QtTest** for QObject/QThread/QSignalSpy seams (the headless
  `OptimizeCoordinator`), run under `QCoreApplication` with zero GPU/display.
- `test/golden/` — golden-oracle baseline (`baseline.json`, `fem_golden.jts`,
  `fem_oracle_captured.jtak`, `calibration.txt`).
- `test/oracle/` — the GPU-labeled Tier-2 appearance oracle (built, U6).
- `test/qml/` — **Qt Quick Test** for the view layer (plan 007 U6):
  `quick_test_main` harness over the REAL `src/app/experimental/*.qml`
  sources (qrc-aliased, no drift) with injected fake bridges; headless
  (offscreen + `QT_QUICK_CONTROLS_STYLE=Material`, no VTK). The
  `jtml.qml_lint` qmllint gate (Qt 6.7.2 binary) runs from `test/`
  (`test/qml_lint.cmake`).

Conventions:
- **QtTest for Qt/threading seams; Catch2 for pure math.** Both register via CTest.
- **Prefer hegel property-based tests for extracted pure logic.** When a piece of pure,
  CUDA/Qt-free logic has invariants worth locking down (length preservation,
  collision-freedom, monotonicity, determinism), add a hegel PBT test alongside its
  deterministic Catch2 unit test — PBT complements, never replaces, the deterministic cases.
  See `test/HEGEL-PBT-GUIDE.md` for the authoring patterns, built-in generator survey, and
  how to discover the hegel API.
- **Default `headless` label must never touch GPU, VTK render, or a widget.** GPU/real-VTK
  cases go under a separate `oracle`/`gpu` label, run explicitly on a GPU machine.
- **New Qt test target gotcha:** CMake AUTOMOC does not auto-moc an included shared header,
  so add the Q_OBJECT header to the `add_executable(...)` source list (see
  `jtml_test_coordinator` in `test/CMakeLists.txt`).
- `QSignalSpy` must observe a signal on the **main/test thread**, never the worker thread
  (QTBUG-2842) — the coordinator re-emits on its own thread.

## The in-flight refactor (testability + MVVM)

## Architecture & Structure

### 1. `src/coordinator/optimizer_manager.cpp` — the Optimize() stage loop (current shape)

`OptimizerManager::Optimize()` (thread slot, connected to `QThread::started` in `Initialize`) runs, per frame in `img_indices_`:

| Landmark | Line (current) |
|---|---|
| Per-frame budget/call reset: `budget_ = trunk_budget; cost_function_calls_ = 0;` | 995–996 |
| `search_stage_flag_ = Trunk;` + `start_clock_`/`update_screen_clock_` | 999, 1002–1003 |
| Trunk: `trunk_manager_.InitializeActiveCostFunction` → dilate(trunk val, both cams) → `emit UpdateDilationBackground()` → `RunDirectStage(trunk_range, trunk_manager_)` → **unconditional** `DestructActiveCostFunction` | 1010–1046 |
| Branch group init (gated `enable_branch_ && number_branches > 0 && !error_occurrred_`): init → dilate(branch val) → emit — **once, outside the repeat loop** | 1052–1076 |
| Branch repeat loop: `for (branch_index < enable_branch_ * number_branches)` with `if (error_occurrred_) break;`; per repeat: `search_stage_flag_ = Branch`; `SetStartingPoint(current_optimum_location_)`; `SetSearchRange(branch_range)`; `budget_ += branch_budget`; `RunDirectStage(branch_range, branch_manager_)` | 1080–1102 |
| Leaf group init (gated `enable_leaf_ && !error_occurrred_`): init → dilate(leaf val) → emit | 1111–1132 |
| `if (sym_trap_call) CalculateSymTrap();` — between leaf emit and search | 1135 |
| Leaf search (gated `enable_leaf_ && !error_occurrred_ && !sym_trap_call`): `search_stage_flag_ = Leaf`; re-seed; `budget_ += leaf_budget`; `RunDirectStage(leaf_range, leaf_manager_)` | 1139–1156 |
| Leaf destruct — **error-gated** `if (enable_leaf_ && !error_occurrred_)` (asymmetry vs trunk's unconditional destruct) | 1158–1163 |
| Epilogue: dilate(trunk val) + emit + `emit OptimizedFrame(...)` | 1170–1189 |
| Meter site #1: `emit UpdateDisplay((clock()-start_clock_)/cost_function_calls_, ...)` end-of-frame | 1206–1211 |

**Key facts for the plan:**
- The stage *shape* is hard-coded (trunk → branch×N → leaf), but budgets/ranges come from `OptimizerSettings`; defaults in `include/domain/settings_constants.h:25,30,31,36`: `TRUNK_BUDGET=20000`, `BRANCH_BUDGET=5000`, `NUMBER_BRANCHES=2`, `Z_SEARCH_BUDGET=5000`. **The "trunk 20k → 2×branch 5k → leaf 5k" claim is the *defaults* (cumulative 20/25/30/35k), confirmed by `test/golden/baseline.json` (`budget_cumulative_effective: [20000, 25000, 30000, 35000]`).** Budget is cumulative by design: trunk resets, branch/leaf accumulate via `budget_ +=`; `RunDirectStage` reads `budget_` + `SetCallOffset(cost_function_calls_)`.
- **The three CFM members:** `trunk_manager_`, `branch_manager_`, `leaf_manager_` (header ~lines 100–102), passed **by value** into `Initialize(...)` (manager works on copies), `UploadData` per stage with per-stage GPU frame vectors (`gpu_dilated_frames_{trunk,branch,leaf}_{A,B}_`, `gpu_intensity_frames_*`, shared `gpu_edge_frames_*`, `gpu_distance_maps_`, `gpu_heatmaps_`). Dilation/dark-silhouette values derived by a parameter-name scan (optimizer_manager.cpp:237–345) — the exact block `DeriveStageCostParams` must relocate verbatim (name variants "Dilation"/"DILATION"/"dilation", ≤0→0 clamp, `DIRECT_MAHFOUZ → 3` special case, six dark-silhouette names).
- **Sym-trap path:** `opt_directive == "Sym_Trap"` → `sym_trap_call = true` → `CalculateSymTrap()` (line 1303): hard-coded `iter_val = 60` (comment says `iter_count * 3`), `create_vector_of_poses(..., 20)`, `EvaluateCostFunctionAtPoint(pose_list.at(i), 2)` (stage 2 = **leaf** manager, line ~1338–1361), 5s total sleep, writes `Results.csv`/`Results.xyz`/`Results2D.xy`, emits `onUpdateOrientationSymTrap`/`onProgressBarUpdate`. Confirms angle 04's `repeat=0` StageSpec semantics: leaf init+dilate+emit still runs, only the search is suppressed.
- **Two ms/call meter sites:** (a) 1206–1211 (end-of-frame), (b) 1282–1287 (inside `RunDirectStage`'s `SetIterationCallback`, ~30fps throttle `(clock() - update_screen_clock_) > 33`). Both emit `(clock() - start_clock_) / calls` — **CPU clock ticks per call, not ms** (Linux `CLOCKS_PER_SEC=1e6` → µs/call), while `mainscreen.cpp:4582 onUpdateDisplay` interprets it as ms/call via `div(remaining_calls / (1000.0 / iteration_speed), 60)`. This is the synthesis's Finding 11 (1000× unit error + CPU-time blind spot); mechanism verified.
- **Terminology nuance:** "costCalls/stageText" bookkeeping is **not** in the manager — the manager tracks `budget_` / `cost_function_calls_` / `search_stage_flag_` (`SearchStageFlag {Trunk=0, Branch=1, Leaf=2}`, `include/domain/metric_enum.h:9`). The `cost_calls_`/`stage_text_` names live in `OptimizerRunControllerCore` (`refreshProgress`, `StageLabel`, optimizer_run_controller_core.cpp:43–73). The synthesis's stage-bookkeeping gate (costCalls landing on 20k/25k/30k/35k) is a function of the *core's* progress mapping, which is counter-derived from the cumulative call count — the oracle seam (M12).

### 3. `include/domain/direct_optimizer.h` + `src/domain/direct_optimizer.cpp` — the extracted DIRECT

- Pure, Qt/VTK/CUDA-free; `std::function<double(const Point6D&)>` injected cost, invoked with the **denormalized physical** point (`DenormalizeFromCenter`). Loop: seed eval at unit center → `while ((cost_function_calls_ + call_offset_) < budget_ && !stop_requested_) { ConvexHull(); TrisectPotentiallyOptimal(); ... }` — the **cumulative** guard (offset 0 ⇒ identical to original `calls < budget`).
- `SetCallOffset(offset)`; `GetCostFunctionCalls() = cost_function_calls_ + call_offset_` (so the manager's write-back `cost_function_calls_ = opt.GetCostFunctionCalls()` keeps the running total). Improvement callback fires on new best (mirrors old UpdateOptimum); iteration callback is post-iteration (the cooperative break boundary).
- Split rule: `TrisectPotentiallyOptimal` — largest **denormalized** side (`DenormalizeRange(GetSides()).GetLargestDirection()`), one-side trisection (keep original center + two shifted), epsilon-free Jarvis gift-wrap with `slope >= highest_slope` — matches synthesis's Options-defaults mapping line-by-line (selection=Original, ε=0.0, split_rule=OneSide, L2 size, cumulative-budget guard).
- **Stale-comment flag:** direct_optimizer.h:19–20 says "trunk 10k → branch 20k → leaf 30k" — an illustrative example that does **not** match production defaults (20k/5k×2/5k → cumulative 20/25/30/35k). Minor doc inconsistency; the code itself is settings-driven.
- Ctor call sites verified 4-arg today: optimizer_manager.cpp:1243 (function def at 1234 — synthesis cited 1234 for the ctor, slight drift), oracle_test.cpp:292, optimize_coordinator.cpp:36, plus 12 in the two direct-optimizer test files.

## Implementation Patterns

- **Named registry + name-string dispatch** (CostFunctionManager `listCostFunctions` + if/else chains) — the pattern R2 says the graph registry mirrors.
- **Injected-cost boundary** (`DirectOptimizer::CostFunction = std::function<double(const Point6D&)>`) — the pattern BuildGpuCostAdapter keeps; three consumers converge (RunDirectStage lambda :1243–1252, oracle twin oracle_test.cpp:288–291, z-profile probe future).
- **Cumulative-budget accounting:** `SetCallOffset` + guard `(calls + offset) < budget_`; manager write-back keeps the running total; the core's progress mapping is a pure function of (budget struct, calls).
- **Direct-compile test pattern:** compile pure .cpp sources into the test target instead of linking heavy libs (jtml_test_direct_optimizer, etc.); heavy Qt/CUDA surface only where the seam demands it.
- **Signal-relay pattern:** manager signals → shell relays by value (QTBUG-2842 — QSignalSpy must observe on main/test thread); epoch + sender guard for stale relays.

## Architecture & Structure

### 1. `src/coordinator/optimizer_manager.cpp` — the Optimize() stage loop (current shape)

`OptimizerManager::Optimize()` (thread slot, connected to `QThread::started` in `Initialize`) runs, per frame in `img_indices_`:

| Landmark | Line (current) |
|---|---|
| Per-frame budget/call reset: `budget_ = trunk_budget; cost_function_calls_ = 0;` | 995–996 |
| `search_stage_flag_ = Trunk;` + `start_clock_`/`update_screen_clock_` | 999, 1002–1003 |

## Implementation Patterns

- **Named registry + name-string dispatch** (CostFunctionManager `listCostFunctions` + if/else chains) — the pattern R2 says the graph registry mirrors.
- **Injected-cost boundary** (`DirectOptimizer::CostFunction = std::function<double(const Point6D&)>`) — the pattern BuildGpuCostAdapter keeps; three consumers converge (RunDirectStage lambda :1243–1252, oracle twin oracle_test.cpp:288–291, z-profile probe future).
- **Cumulative-budget accounting:** `SetCallOffset` + guard `(calls + offset) < budget_`; manager write-back keeps the running total; the core's progress mapping is a pure function of (budget struct, calls).
- **Direct-compile test pattern:** compile pure .cpp sources into the test target instead of linking heavy libs (jtml_test_direct_optimizer, etc.); heavy Qt/CUDA surface only where the seam demands it.
- **Signal-relay pattern:** manager signals → shell relays by value (QTBUG-2842 — QSignalSpy must observe on main/test thread); epoch + sender guard for stale relays.
